sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 17 at 10:45AM PST until November 18 at 10:00PM PST by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South to southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55
mph expected.

* WHERE...For the Delta, Foothills, Sacramento Valley, and northern
San Joaquin Valley.

* WHEN...From 10 PM this evening to 10 PM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest winds are expected Wednesday morning
and afternoon.

alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 17 at 10:44AM PST until November 19 at 7:00PM PST by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Snow accumulations up to 4 inches below 5000 feet with
4 to 8 inches above 5000 feet including foothill areas west of
Highway 395 and Virginia City.

* WHERE...Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden Area.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Wednesday to 7 PM PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Wednesday evening and the Thursday
morning and evening commutes.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A rain and snow mix may limit accumulations on
valley floors until snow levels fall to 4500 feet or less Wednesday
evening.
